title: ‘एक चिहान’ उपन्यासमा शक्ति सम्बन्ध
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख हृदयचन्द्रसिंह प्रधानद्वारा लेखिएको एक चिहान उपन्यासको शक्ति सम्बन्धसँग सम्बद्ध छ । शक्तिसम्बन्धलाई सांस्कृतिक अध्ययनका क्षेत्रमा विकसित एउटा नवीन समालोचनात्मक सैद्धान्तिक अवधारणा मानिन्छ । शक्ति सम्बन्धी मान्यतालाई मसेल फुको र अन्तोनियो ग्राम्चीले अघि सारेका हुन् । समाजमा अस्तित्वमा रहेका विभिन्न लिङ्ग, जाति, वर्ग तथा क्षेत्रीयताका बीचमा शक्तिको के–कस्तो सम्बन्ध रहेको छ भन्ने कुरालाई नै शक्तिसम्बन्ध भनिन्छ । यहाँ यसै मान्यताको आधारमा रही उपन्यास भित्र रहेको शक्तिसम्बन्धलाई विश्लेषण गरी निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । उपन्यासमा शक्तिसम्बन्धको सूक्ष्म विश्लेषण गर्नका लागि मूलतःलिङ्ग, वर्ग तथा जातिलाई आधार मानी विवेच्य उपन्यासमा प्रयु क्त कथ्य र सहभागीको अध्ययन गरिएको छ । आर्थिक असमानताका कारण सिर्जित समस्यालाई मूल कथ्य बनाइएको एक चिहान उपन्यासमा समाजमा उच्च ठानिएका सामन्त वर्गले लिङ्ग, वर्ग तथा जातिका नाममा निम्नवर्गमाथि दमन गरी सीमान्तीकृत बनाएको तर निम्नवर्गले त्यसका विरुद्ध प्रतिरोध गरेर शक्तिको केन्द्रमा पुग्न सफल भएको निष्कर्ष प्राप्त भएको छ ।
american_english: The present article is concerned with power relations in the novel Ek Chihan written by Hridayachandra Singh Pradhan. Power relations are considered a novel critical theoretical concept developed in the field of cultural studies. The conception regarding power was put forward by Michel Foucault and Antonio Gramsci. What kind of relationship of power exists among different genders, castes, classes, and regionalities in society is precisely what is called power relations. Here, on the basis of this very premise, the power relations within the novel have been analyzed and conclusions drawn. In order to conduct a micro-analysis of power relations in the novel, primarily taking gender, class, and caste as the basis, the narrative and participants employed in the novel under discussion have been studied. In the novel Ek Chihan, in which problems created due to economic inequality are made the central narrative, the conclusion has been reached that the feudal class considered high in society oppressed and marginalized the lower class in the name of gender, class, and caste, but the lower class resisted against this and succeeded in reaching the center of power.

informal_english: This article is all about power relations in the novel Ek Chihan written by Hridayachandra Singh Pradhan. Power relations are considered a fresh critical theoretical concept developed in the field of cultural studies. The whole idea regarding power was put forward by Michel Foucault and Antonio Gramsci. What kind of relationship of power exists among different genders, castes, classes, and regionalities in society is basically what is called power relations. Right here, on the basis of this very premise, power relations inside the novel have been analyzed and conclusions drawn. In order to do a micro-analysis of power relations in the novel, mainly taking gender, class, and caste as the basis, the narrative and characters used in the novel have been studied. In the novel Ek Chihan, where problems created by economic inequality are made the central story, the conclusion reached is that the feudal class deemed high in society oppressed and marginalized the lower class in the name of gender, class, and caste, but the lower class fought back and managed to reach the center of power.
